subject: Future Tech
title: Jobs Lost and Created
description: A quick win: understand Jobs Lost and Created.

hook.text: 3.5 million truck drivers, 300,000 taxi drivers, 1 million delivery drivers.

buildup.text: Driving is the most common job in 29 US states. Automation threatens the economic backbone of entire regions.

discovery.text: But AVs also create jobs: fleet operators, remote monitors, data labelers, maintenance technicians, urban planners.

twist.text: The new jobs require different skills than driving. Without massive retraining programs, displaced workers are stranded.

climax.text: History shows automation creates more jobs than it destroys long-term.

punchline.text: The jobs will change. The question is who gets left behind.

quiz.question: In how many US states is driving the most common job?
